property_summary: After the owner initializes balances via NETM(), the owner's token balance must equal totalSupply() - totalRemaining() (i.e. the total distributed so far); the mutant credits totalRemaining instead, so once a prior getTokens() makes totalRemaining differ from totalDistributed the equality breaks.
change_summary: Replace the assignment balances[owner] = totalDistributed with balances[owner] = totalRemaining, crediting the owner a different amount.
